controls: the base is seen to fail the maintainers' tests (validate)
the maintainers' fix, as a patch, is seen to pass them (selfcheck)
an empty patch is seen to fail them (selfcheck)

the base and the empty patch by one rule: a failure in a test result, or a collection error, in pytest's own report, of a fail-to-pass test's module where the gold patch's run on the same image ids saw it pass
each test known by the node id pytest's own report gives it, never by its junit key
a known patch written through the host executor's runner is read back byte for byte in the kept patch (round trip)
each ran on both of the bug's image ids here, read again after them; a result not known is no pass and no failure, and excludes the bug
